verdict.rationale: The franchise-tax/annual-report page publishes an operating-hours window up front ('available daily between 8:00 am and 11:45 pm Eastern Time'), so a founder sees it before starting. The portal also mentions saved sessions but publishes no session timeout or per-day limit, so the story's disclosure is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: published session-timeout duration, any per-day limit disclosure, hours disclosure for the formation/document-filing service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: This application is available daily between 8:00 am and 11:45 pm Eastern Time.
